description: Happy path: the students module reads Orgs, Institutes, and Students from RavenDB, creates the target schema, and upserts 1 organization + 1 institute + 1 student (single enrollment with a resolvable institute) inside one transaction; prints the verbatim progress/summary lines, writes the migration summary JSON, and exits 0.
notes: All expected strings, identity precedence chains, enum mappings, and the summary shape are lifted verbatim from students_ravendb_to_postgres_migrate.py - nothing hand-invented. PII (names, Aadhaar, UDID, PAN, contacts, photo URL) is synthesized per the adapter. Nondeterministic values (timestamps, summary filename, new-vs-updated split on re-runs) are asserted by rule. Capture against a live legacy run (reachable RavenDB + PostgreSQL + .env + .pfx cert) to set validated_against_legacy=true.

environment.working_directory: repository root (script run directly: python scripts/migrations/students_ravendb_to_postgres_migrate.py, or as the `students` child of migrate_all.py)
environment.env_precedence: no RAVEN_*/PG_* variables pre-set in the host environment (so .env values apply)

given.postgres_state: database reachable; the three target tables do not exist yet (clean first run)

stdout_lines: RavenDB target: url=https://<reachable-cluster>.ravendb.cloud, db=BTL, collections=(Orgs, Institutes, Students)

stdout_assert_rules.banner_numbering: mixed denominators [1/5],[2/5] then [3/6]..[6/6] are legacy-verbatim (cosmetic divergence, see spec open item 10)
stdout_assert_rules.summary_json_path: matches ^validation/migration-summary-\d{8}_\d{6}\.json$ resolved to an absolute path

organization_row.name: Test Org One
organization_row.note: id derived from FIRST uuid in SourceOrgId string, lowercased (source-field precedence, not metadata)

institute_row.name: Test Institute One
institute_row.note: numeric status 1 maps through inst_status/parse_institute_status to enum 'Active'

student_row.id_assert_rule: derived from @metadata.@id UUID FIRST (student-only precedence), lowercased
student_row.inst_id_assert_rule: resolved because the institute row was loaded in the same transaction before students
student_row.name: Test Student One

enrollments.shape: JSONB array of 1 element with CourseName/TermName/SectionName/RollNo/StudentId/InstId preserved verbatim from the source document

fees_receivable.shape: JSONB object copied verbatim (boundary re-homing: fees-context blob, see spec open item 5)

attendance.shape: JSONB object copied verbatim (boundary re-homing: academics-context blob, see spec open item 5)

summary_json.generated_at_utc_assert_rule: ISO-8601 ending in Z; do not assert literally

api_payload_validation.baseline_assert_rule: baseline filters hard-coded to courseName='I', section='A', term='Annual' - on this synthetic dataset Data arrays are expected EMPTY while the run still succeeds (see spec open item 8)

nondeterministic_fields: on re-run (same input twice): run_stats processed counts stay 1 but new_*_inserted become 0 (upsert updates in place, full-row overwrite incl. created_on - see spec open item 7)
known_unstated: divergent cases (unparseable status, PK-less document, missing enrollment institute, live-source mutation between pages) are reified as open items in specs/migration/etl-module-students.md and deliberately not encoded as passing expectations
